select u.id as userId, u.username as username, u.email as email, u.avatar as avatar, latest.member_type as memberType, case latest.member_type when 'vip' then 'VIP Member' when 'small_class' then 'Small Class Member' else latest.member_type end as memberTypeName, latest.plan_name_snapshot as planName, case when latest.expire_time is not null and latest.expire_time > now() then 1 else 0 end as memberActive, date_format(latest.expire_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as memberExpireTime, coalesce(course_total.total_course_count, 0) as totalCourseCount, coalesce(progress_summary.started_course_count, 0) as startedCourseCount, coalesce(progress_summary.completed_course_count, 0) as completedCourseCount, case when coalesce(course_total.total_course_count, 0) > 0 then round(coalesce(progress_summary.total_progress_percent, 0) / course_total.total_course_count, 2) else 0.00 end as overallProgress, case when coalesce(course_total.total_course_count, 0) > 0 then round(coalesce(progress_summary.started_course_count, 0) * 100.00 / course_total.total_course_count, 2) else 0.00 end as startRate, case when coalesce(course_total.total_course_count, 0) > 0 then round(coalesce(progress_summary.completed_course_count, 0) * 100.00 / course_total.total_course_count, 2) else 0.00 end as completionRate, date_format(progress_summary.last_learn_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastLearnTime from osh_user u inner join ( select mo.user_id, mo.member_type, mo.plan_name_snapshot, mo.expire_time from osh_member_order mo inner join ( select user_id, max(id) as max_id from osh_member_order where pay_status = 1 and delete_flag = 0 group by user_id ) latest_order on latest_order.max_id = mo.id ) latest on latest.user_id = u.id left join ( select t.user_id, count(distinct t.course_id) as total_course_count from ( select ocb.user_id, ocb.course_id from osh_course_buy ocb where ocb.pay_status = 'paid' and ocb.delete_flag = 0 union all select oucp.user_id, oucp.course_id from osh_user_course_progress oucp where oucp.delete_flag = 0 ) t group by t.user_id ) course_total on course_total.user_id = u.id left join ( select user_id, count(distinct course_id) as started_course_count, sum(coalesce(progress_percent, 0)) as total_progress_percent, sum(case when coalesce(is_completed, 0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as completed_course_count, max(last_learn_time) as last_learn_time from osh_user_course_progress where delete_flag = 0 group by user_id ) progress_summary on progress_summary.user_id = u.id where u.delete_flag = 0
and (u.username like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or u.email like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
and latest.member_type = #{query.memberType}
and latest.expire_time is not null and latest.expire_time > now()
order by case when latest.expire_time is not null and latest.expire_time > now() then 1 else 0 end desc, progress_summary.last_learn_time desc, latest.expire_time desc, u.id desc

select u.id as userId, u.username as username, u.email as email, u.avatar as avatar, latest.member_type as memberType, case latest.member_type when 'vip' then 'VIP Member' when 'small_class' then 'Small Class Member' else latest.member_type end as memberTypeName, latest.plan_name_snapshot as planName, case when latest.expire_time is not null and latest.expire_time > now() then 1 else 0 end as memberActive, date_format(latest.expire_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as memberExpireTime, coalesce(course_total.total_course_count, 0) as totalCourseCount, coalesce(progress_summary.started_course_count, 0) as startedCourseCount, coalesce(progress_summary.completed_course_count, 0) as completedCourseCount, greatest(coalesce(course_total.total_course_count, 0) - coalesce(progress_summary.started_course_count, 0), 0) as unstartedCourseCount, case when coalesce(course_total.total_course_count, 0) > 0 then round(coalesce(progress_summary.total_progress_percent, 0) / course_total.total_course_count, 2) else 0.00 end as overallProgress, case when coalesce(course_total.total_course_count, 0) > 0 then round(coalesce(progress_summary.started_course_count, 0) * 100.00 / course_total.total_course_count, 2) else 0.00 end as startRate, case when coalesce(course_total.total_course_count, 0) > 0 then round(coalesce(progress_summary.completed_course_count, 0) * 100.00 / course_total.total_course_count, 2) else 0.00 end as completionRate, date_format(progress_summary.first_learn_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as firstLearnTime, date_format(progress_summary.last_learn_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastLearnTime from osh_user u inner join ( select mo.user_id, mo.member_type, mo.plan_name_snapshot, mo.expire_time from osh_member_order mo inner join ( select user_id, max(id) as max_id from osh_member_order where pay_status = 1 and delete_flag = 0 group by user_id ) latest_order on latest_order.max_id = mo.id ) latest on latest.user_id = u.id left join ( select t.user_id, count(distinct t.course_id) as total_course_count from ( select ocb.user_id, ocb.course_id from osh_course_buy ocb where ocb.pay_status = 'paid' and ocb.delete_flag = 0 union all select oucp.user_id, oucp.course_id from osh_user_course_progress oucp where oucp.delete_flag = 0 ) t group by t.user_id ) course_total on course_total.user_id = u.id left join ( select user_id, count(distinct course_id) as started_course_count, sum(coalesce(progress_percent, 0)) as total_progress_percent, sum(case when coalesce(is_completed, 0) = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as completed_course_count, min(create_time) as first_learn_time, max(last_learn_time) as last_learn_time from osh_user_course_progress where delete_flag = 0 group by user_id ) progress_summary on progress_summary.user_id = u.id where u.delete_flag = 0 and u.id = #{userId} limit 1

select c.id as courseId, c.title as courseTitle, c.cover as courseCover, case when bought.course_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as purchasedFlag, case when p.course_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as startedFlag, coalesce(p.learned_section_count, 0) as learnedSectionCount, coalesce(p.total_section_count, 0) as totalSectionCount, coalesce(p.progress_percent, 0.00) as progressPercent, coalesce(p.is_completed, 0) as completedFlag, case when coalesce(p.is_completed, 0) = 1 then 3 when coalesce(section_status.has_paused, 0) = 1 then 2 when p.course_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as progressStatus, case when coalesce(p.is_completed, 0) = 1 then 'Completed' when coalesce(section_status.has_paused, 0) = 1 then 'Paused' when p.course_id is not null then 'Learning' else 'Not Started' end as progressStatusName, date_format(bought.purchase_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as purchaseTime, date_format(p.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startLearnTime, date_format(p.last_learn_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastLearnTime from ( select base.course_id, min(base.purchase_time) as purchase_time from ( select ocb.course_id, ocb.pay_time as purchase_time from osh_course_buy ocb where ocb.user_id = #{userId} and ocb.pay_status = 'paid' and ocb.delete_flag = 0 union all select oucp.course_id, oucp.create_time as purchase_time from osh_user_course_progress oucp where oucp.user_id = #{userId} and oucp.delete_flag = 0 ) base group by base.course_id ) bought inner join osh_course c on c.id = bought.course_id and c.delete_flag = 0 left join osh_user_course_progress p on p.user_id = #{userId} and p.course_id = bought.course_id and p.delete_flag = 0 left join ( select user_id, course_id, max(case when status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as has_paused from osh_user_learn_progress where user_id = #{userId} and delete_flag = 0 group by user_id, course_id ) section_status on section_status.user_id = #{userId} and section_status.course_id = bought.course_id where 1 = 1
and p.course_id is not null
and c.title like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
order by coalesce(p.last_learn_time, bought.purchase_time) desc, c.id desc

select p.user_id as userId, p.job_status as jobStatus, p.job_status_name as jobStatusName, p.company_name as companyName, p.position_name as positionName, p.city as city, p.salary_before as salaryBefore, p.salary_after as salaryAfter, p.target_salary as targetSalary, case when p.salary_before is not null and p.salary_after is not null then round(p.salary_after - p.salary_before, 2) else null end as salaryIncrease, date_format(p.entry_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as entryTime, p.case_eligible as caseEligible, p.remark as remark, p.resume_delivery_count as resumeDeliveryCount, p.interview_company_count as interviewCompanyCount, p.pending_interview_count as pendingInterviewCount, p.completed_interview_count as completedInterviewCount, p.interview_round_count as interviewRoundCount, p.interview_status as interviewStatus, p.interview_result as interviewResult, date_format(p.last_interview_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastInterviewTime, p.update_by as updateBy, date_format(p.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime from osh_internal_member_employment_profile p where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.delete_flag = 0 limit 1

select p.user_id as userId, p.resume_delivery_count as resumeDeliveryCount, date_format(p.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime from osh_internal_member_employment_profile p where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.delete_flag = 0 limit 1

select p.user_id as userId, p.interview_company_count as interviewCompanyCount, p.pending_interview_count as pendingInterviewCount, p.completed_interview_count as completedInterviewCount, p.interview_round_count as interviewRoundCount, p.interview_status as interviewStatus, p.interview_result as interviewResult, date_format(p.last_interview_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as lastInterviewTime, date_format(p.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updateTime from osh_internal_member_employment_profile p where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.delete_flag = 0 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into osh_internal_member_employment_profile ( user_id, job_status, job_status_name, company_name, position_name, city, salary_before, salary_after, target_salary, entry_time, case_eligible, remark, resume_delivery_count, interview_company_count, pending_interview_count, completed_interview_count, interview_round_count, interview_status, interview_result, last_interview_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, delete_flag ) values ( #{userId}, #{dto.jobStatus}, #{dto.jobStatusName}, #{dto.companyName}, #{dto.positionName}, #{dto.city}, #{dto.salaryBefore}, #{dto.salaryAfter}, #{dto.targetSalary}, str_to_date(#{dto.entryTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{dto.caseEligible}, #{dto.remark}, #{dto.resumeDeliveryCount}, #{dto.interviewCompanyCount}, #{dto.pendingInterviewCount}, #{dto.completedInterviewCount}, #{dto.interviewRoundCount}, #{dto.interviewStatus}, #{dto.interviewResult}, str_to_date(#{dto.lastInterviewTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0 )
mapper.update: update osh_internal_member_employment_profile set job_status = #{dto.jobStatus}, job_status_name = #{dto.jobStatusName}, company_name = #{dto.companyName}, position_name = #{dto.positionName}, city = #{dto.city}, salary_before = #{dto.salaryBefore}, salary_after = #{dto.salaryAfter}, target_salary = #{dto.targetSalary}, entry_time = str_to_date(#{dto.entryTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), case_eligible = #{dto.caseEligible}, remark = #{dto.remark}, resume_delivery_count = #{dto.resumeDeliveryCount}, interview_company_count = #{dto.interviewCompanyCount}, pending_interview_count = #{dto.pendingInterviewCount}, completed_interview_count = #{dto.completedInterviewCount}, interview_round_count = #{dto.interviewRoundCount}, interview_status = #{dto.interviewStatus}, interview_result = #{dto.interviewResult}, last_interview_time = str_to_date(#{dto.lastInterviewTime}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and delete_flag = 0
mapper.select: select r.id as id, r.user_id as userId, r.follow_type as followType, r.content as content, r.operator_id as operatorId, u.username as operatorName, date_format(r.next_follow_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as nextFollowTime, date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from osh_internal_member_follow_record r left join osh_user u on u.id = r.operator_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.delete_flag = 0 order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc

select r.id as recordId, r.exam_id as examId, e.title as examTitle, e.resource_type as resourceType, e.resource_id as resourceId, r.score as score, e.total_score as totalScore, e.pass_score as passScore, r.answer_status as answerStatus, r.read_status as readStatus, case when r.answer_status = 0 then 'in_progress' when r.answer_status = 1 and r.read_status = 0 then 'pending_read' when r.answer_status = 1 and e.pass_score is not null and coalesce(r.score, 0) >= e.pass_score then 'passed' else 'failed' end as result, date_format(r.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as reportTime from osh_user_exam_record r inner join ( select exam_id, max(id) as max_id from osh_user_exam_record where user_id = #{userId} and delete_flag = 0 group by exam_id ) latest on latest.max_id = r.id left join osh_examination e on e.id = r.exam_id and e.delete_flag = 0 order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc
select count(1) from osh_member_order where user_id = #{userId} and pay_status = 1 and delete_flag = 0
